primary_goal: Get the visitor to add the Apple AirPods Pro 3 (new) to the basket or buy now from the Amazon-fulfilled buy box

friction_points.issue: The primary purchase CTA (Add to Basket / Buy Now) is not visible. The upper part of the buy box is covered by a large blank white area, so the main conversion action cannot be seen.
friction_points.evidence: A large white rectangle covers the top-right of the page, from the header across the buy-box column. Below it, only fragments are visible: '€191', 'FREE delivery Tuesday, 3 November', 'Dispatches from Amazon / Sold by: Amazon Retourenkauf' and an 'Add to List' dropdown. No basket or buy button is visible.

friction_points.issue: Two different prices compete for attention, and the buy box appears to default to a used or returned offer instead of the new product shown in the main price block.
friction_points.evidence: The centre column shows '-17% €206' with 'RRP: €249.00'. The buy box shows '€191' under a cut-off label ending in '...Very Good' and 'Sold by: Amazon Retourenkauf'. Below it: 'New & Used (9) from €191'.

friction_points.issue: The page sends buyers away from the default offer by advertising cheaper alternatives right next to the main price.
friction_points.evidence: Under the price block: 'May be available at a lower price from other sellers, potentially without Prime shipping.' The right column also has an 'Other sellers on Amazon' module.

friction_points.issue: The interface language is inconsistent. The UI and bullets are in English, while the brand A+ content and the comparison chart are entirely in German.
friction_points.evidence: The header shows the 'EN' language selector and English labels ('About this item', 'Customers usually keep this item'). The A+ section reads 'Die weltbeste Aktive Geräuschunterdrückung bei In-Ear Kopfhörern.' and 'Welche AirPods sind die richtigen für dich?'

friction_points.issue: The centre column is very narrow, so the title and bullets become long, dense text walls that are hard to scan. The ALL-CAPS bullet lead-ins add to this.
friction_points.evidence: The product title wraps over about 10 lines. The 'About this item' bullets begin with 'THE WORLD'S BEST ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLATION IN-EAR HEADPHONES', 'BETTER FIT IN THE EAR', 'PERSONALISED LISTENING EXPERIENCE' and run as long, narrow paragraphs.

friction_points.issue: The comparison chart is long and sparse. Many cells are empty, and the icons and text are tiny, so it adds scroll length without making the choice easier.
friction_points.evidence: The 'Welche AirPods sind die richtigen für dich?' table has four columns (AirPods 4, AirPods 4 mit ANC, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods Max) with many cells containing only '–' and very small icon labels, spanning a large vertical area.

friction_points.issue: Payment options common in Germany are not shown near the price. Only an instalment plan is visible.
friction_points.evidence: The price area shows 'Or €34.50 per month (6 months) with 0% APR Select plan'. No PayPal, Klarna or invoice (Rechnung) badges are visible anywhere on the page.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we keep the Add to Basket / Buy Now buttons fully visible and unobstructed in the first viewport, then add-to-cart rate will improve because the primary action will be immediately findable.
hypotheses.change: Remove or fix the white overlay or flyout covering the buy box, and pin the buy box CTA above the fold on desktop

hypotheses.hypothesis: If the buy box defaults to the new, Amazon-sold offer at €206 and shows used or returned offers only as a secondary option, then conversion on the new SKU will improve because price and condition will match the main price block.
hypotheses.change: Set the default buy-box offer to 'New – sold by Amazon' and move the 'Used – Very Good €191' offer to a secondary 'More buying choices' link

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we remove the 'May be available at a lower price from other sellers' line next to the price, then add-to-cart rate will improve because fewer visitors will leave to compare offers.
hypotheses.change: Remove or visually de-emphasise the 'lower price from other sellers' notice in the price block

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we rewrite the bullets as short, sentence-case benefit statements with a bold 2–3 word lead-in, then engagement and add-to-cart rate will improve because key benefits (ANC, 8h battery, heart rate, IP57) will be scannable in seconds.
hypotheses.change: Replace the ALL-CAPS long bullets with 5 concise bullets of about 15 words each and widen the centre column

hypotheses.hypothesis: If the A+ content language matches the selected interface language, then add-to-cart rate will improve for English-UI visitors because they will understand the brand content without switching languages.
hypotheses.change: Serve an English A+ module when 'EN' is selected (and German bullets when 'DE' is selected)

quick_wins: Convert the ALL-CAPS bullet lead-ins in 'About this item' to sentence case
Remove empty '–' rows in the comparison chart, or replace them with a clear 'not available' marker
Shorten the product title to the core product name and key features (e.g. 'Apple AirPods Pro 3 – ANC, Heart Rate, USB-C')
Make the condition label ('New' / 'Used – Very Good') prominent next to every buy-box price
Increase the font size of icon labels in the comparison chart so they are legible
uncertainties: Whether the white block over the buy box is a real rendering bug or an artifact of the full-page screenshot (e.g. an open flyout)
Whether Add to Basket and Buy Now buttons exist beneath the covered area
Which payment methods are offered at checkout (PayPal, Klarna, invoice); these are not visible on this page
Whether the Impressum and legal links are present in the footer, which is not shown in the screenshot
Mobile layout and behaviour, since only a desktop view is visible
Exact cents of the prices and the review count, which are too small to read reliably
Actual traffic mix (EN vs DE UI users), which determines how much the language mismatch matters
